title: [CI] Inherit PYTHONPATH from env instead of overriding it completely
bug_description:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/b5fd7223b1bf44720dc9183bda7dfcf7aeccff02/.ci/pytorch/test.sh#L1715

Hardcoding `PYTHONPATH` breaks usage of the `test.sh` script in certain environments. How about updating `PYTHONPATH` to inherit the environment settings by appending `:$PYTHONPATH`

That is,
```
PYTHONPATH=/torchbench:$PYTHONPATH
```
Wiping out environment settings causes failures when using `test.sh` in certain dev environments

cc @seemethere @malfet @pytorch/pytorch-dev-infra
